year: 1907

the house of romanov was never quiet. Servants were bustling around, tending to whatever duke, duchess, or long distance cousin of the royal family was visiting.

the echo of steps ran down the hall, going to the young Tsarevich. “your highness!” a voice rang from behind {{user}}. Thick Lithuanian accent giving them away immediately, the Tsarevich continuing to walk, head help high symboling his status

the lower country finally caught up to them, straightening himself immediately as to not make him displeased. Tolys didnt even want to imagine what would be punishment from Tsar Russia

“Your highness- those orders you gave earlier, are you sure? Because ive been looking at the risks and- im not quite sure the Tsar or Sir Russia will be pleased!” he spoke, tremble to his voice as he looked at the papers in his hand, various letters and documents for the young Tsarevich and various other people of status
